normalized.description: Since 2012, the Netherlands Space Office has been purchasing satellite data on behalf of the Dutch government and making these data available free of charge to Dutch entities via the Satellite Data Portal (http://www.satellietdataportaal.nl, ftp.satellietdataportaal.nl, and api.satellietdataportaal.nl).
